name: CellArray_ptr

name: BuildingClass_slot73
one_line_semantics: 建筑主状态切换 slot73；mode0=Limbo摘链/1,3=Unlimbo挂链/2未证；挂链含can-place两处

name: CellCanPlaceScan
one_line_semantics: 逐格占用校验；S12-K2称只扫headA(+0xE4)按WhatAmI判6/0x24拒；本卡旁路开关全关⇒校验全开

name: CanPlaceBackupBranch
one_line_semantics: byte[0xA8ED6B]==0 进入的另一校验分支；本卡读=0

name: CellAttachWorker
one_line_semantics: 挂链worker；按对象+0x8C byte选headA/headB；本卡可放置对象+0x8C全0⇒恒headA

name: ChainBitReadSite
one_line_semantics: 读对象+0x8C作为0x47E8A0的byte参（S12-K2 #9，静态推断）

name: LayerIndex
one_line_semantics: ObjectClass+0x94=层索引；本卡链上对象实测=2

name: CellHeadBOffset
one_line_semantics: CellClass+0xE8 链头B偏移；本卡可放置对象恒空
